description: This file implements a command for listing chat channels and authentication providers, including formatting and output logic, with support for JSON output and usage reporting.

methods.name: formatEnabled
methods.description: Formats a boolean value indicating if a channel is enabled, returning a themed string.

methods.name: formatConfigured
methods.description: Formats a boolean indicating if a channel is configured, returning a themed string.

methods.name: formatTokenSource
methods.description: Formats a token source string with color coding.

methods.name: formatSource
methods.description: Formats a source label with color coding.

methods.name: formatLinked
methods.description: Formats a boolean indicating if a channel is linked.

methods.name: shouldShowConfigured
methods.description: Determines if the configured status should be shown for a channel.

methods.name: formatAccountLine
methods.description: Creates a formatted string representing a channel account's status and configuration.

methods.name: loadUsageWithProgress
methods.description: Loads usage data with a progress indicator, handling errors.

methods.name: channelsListCommand
methods.description: Main function to list channels and auth providers, outputting in text or JSON, with optional usage report.
